import io, base64, zstandard as zstd
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,'
        'result,service,attempt,payload')
data=(HEADER+'\r\n').encode()
plain=zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(1,window_log=27,write_content_size=1)
f1=zstd.ZstdCompressor(compression_params=plain).compress(data)
print('window 27 params',zstd.get_frame_parameters(f1[:20]))
params=zstd.ZstdCompressionParameters.from_level(1,window_log=28,write_content_size=1)
f2=zstd.ZstdCompressor(compression_params=params).compress(data)
print('window 28 params',zstd.get_frame_parameters(f2[:20]), f2[:6].hex())
print('same frame?',f1==f2)
# skippable + concatenated
cctx=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_content_size=True)
f3=cctx.compress(HEADER.encode())
f4=cctx.compress(b'icmp,seen,0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\r\n')
skip=b'\x50\x2a\x4d\x18'+(4).to_bytes(4,'little')+b'abcd'
payload=skip+f3+f4
from classify_responses import complete_frames
print('walk',complete_frames(payload))
try:
    out=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(payload),read_across_frames=True).read()
    print('decomp',out[:80], len(out))
except Exception as e: print('decomp err',type(e).__name__,e)
PYEOF
